info.title: Elastic Docs API
info.description: Search, Ask AI, change feeds, feedback and the API reference behind elastic.co/docs.

get.summary: List the pages that changed since a date
get.description: Lists the pages whose content changed since a date, a batch at a time. Pass the `nextCursor` of a reply as `cursor` to read the next batch, until `hasMore` is false.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Pages changed at or after this date and time, in ISO 8601.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` of the previous reply.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The number of pages per batch.

post.summary: Stream an Ask AI answer as server-sent events
post.description: Answers a question with Elastic's documentation, as a stream of server-sent events. Each `data:` line is a JSON event: `conversation_start`, search and tool calls, `message_chunk` parts of the answer, and `conversation_end`. Pass the conversation id to ask a follow-up.

curl -X POST 'https://www.elastic.co/docs/_api/v1/ask-ai/stream' \

  -d '{"message":"How do I check the health of a cluster?","conversationId":null}'

get.summary: Search, look up by endpoint, or list one API's operations
get.description: Reads an API's operations in one of three ways. With `q`, it searches them by words, a route such as `GET /_cluster/health`, or a field path. With `endpoint`, it finds the operations that serve a request, such as `GET /my-index/_search`, best route first; add `view=full` for their fields. With neither, it lists them by path, one `group` at a time if you like.

parameters.name: api
parameters.description: The API key, such as `elasticsearch`. `GET /docs/_api/v1/apis` lists them.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: The version to read, such as `main` or `9`. Without it, the current version.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Only the operations of this group, such as `Cluster`. Case doesn't matter.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words, a route such as `GET /_cluster/health`, or a field path. End a field with `.`, as in `retriever.`, to list its child fields.

parameters.name: endpoint
parameters.description: A request as you would send it, such as `GET /my-index/_search`, with or without the method.

parameters.name: include_deprecated
parameters.description: Include deprecated operations. The default is `false`.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: `basic` (the default) or `full`, which adds each result's versions and fields. It needs `endpoint`.

parameters.name: include_body
parameters.description: Include the operation page's text. In a lookup by endpoint, it needs `view=full`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page of a search or listing to return, from 1.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The number of operations per page, from 1 to 50.

200.description: A page of operations. A lookup that matches nothing is an empty page, not a 404.
